title: Ten Strategies.
instruction: Select both Blueprint PDFs. Copy either prompt into Chat.
prompt_en: Summarise the Blueprint’s Ten Strategies for secondary-school teachers in a three-column table: Strategy; Suggested teacher action; Citation. Use one row per strategy (ten rows). Keep cells brief and distinguish suggestions from official requirements. Write in English.
prompt_zh: 請為中學教師整理《藍圖》的「十大策略」，用三欄表格：推行策略、建議教師行動、出處。每項策略一行，共十行。內容簡潔，分清建議與官方要求。請以繁體中文回答。
